title: Significance of DPP-4 Inhibition for Glucose Modulation and Its Bioimaging with Small Molecular Probes.
snippet: Diabetes mellitus is a metabolic disease that results from a reduced response to insulin, or a lack of it, either due to a deficiency of insulin or a diminished effectiveness of the insulin. title: FViT: A Foundation-Tokenized Vision Transformer with Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Scale Ensembling for Deep Learning-Based Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histopathology.
snippet: Spatial transcriptomics links gene expression to tissue morphology but is too costly for routine clinical use, motivating prediction of expression from hematoxylin-and-eosin (H&E) images.
